interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY month

input: How many orders, of any status, do we get per customer?

expected.label: ambiguous
expected.note: A list per customer, or a single average (over buyers or over all customers).

interpretations.description: name and order count for each customer who ordered
interpretations.clarifying_answer: Show me the number for each customer.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id

interpretations.description: one average over customers with at least one order
interpretations.clarifying_answer: One average, over customers who have ordered.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders

interpretations.description: one average over all customers, including those with no orders
interpretations.clarifying_answer: One average, over all customers including those who never ordered.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers)

input: How did Electronics revenue develop over 2025?

expected.label: ambiguous
expected.note: Monthly or quarterly breakdown.

interpretations.clarifying_answer: Month by month.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND p.category = 'Electronics' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY month

interpretations.clarifying_answer: Quarter by quarter.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 AS quarter, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND p.category = 'Electronics' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY quarter

input: How many orders, of any status, do we get per day in June 2026?

expected.label: ambiguous
expected.note: A count for each day, or one daily average.

interpretations.description: date and order count for each day of June 2026
interpretations.clarifying_answer: Show each day separately.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_date, COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY o.order_date

interpretations.description: one average: June 2026 orders divided by 30 days
interpretations.clarifying_answer: One average per day.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) / 30.0 FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
